name: autonews-car-info
description: Read-only Korean car life information from AutoNews: recalls, EV chargers, EV subsidy and car tax calculators, car Q&A and car news.

interface.longDescription:
Read-only connector from AutoNews (autonews.kr), a Korean automotive news outlet. It answers everyday car questions in Korea: vehicle recalls (Korea Transportation Safety Authority open data), nationwide EV charging stations with how many chargers are free right now (Korea Environment Corporation open data, refreshed every 10 minutes), EV purchase subsidy and out-of-pocket price estimates, acquisition tax and annual car tax calculations, verified car-life Q&A (tax, registration, inspection, insurance, driving, used cars) and AutoNews car articles. No login and no personal information are needed. Amounts are estimates with the legal basis and the date of the rules, and every answer points to the official site to confirm (ev.or.kr, Wetax, Korea Automobile Recall Center).

자동차 전문 언론 AutoNews 의 자동차 생활정보. 리콜·전기차 충전소·보조금과 세금 계산·자동차 Q&A·기사를 로그인 없이 알려 줍니다.

positive.description: Nearby EV fast chargers available now
positive.prompt: 강남역 근처에 지금 쓸 수 있는 급속 충전기 있어?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns fast-charging stations near Gangnam Station sorted by distance, with how many fast chargers are free now, max power, operator and the status time, citing Korea Environment Corporation data.

positive.prompt: 기본가격 4,990만원 전기차를 내연차 폐차하고 사면 보조금 받고 실구매가 얼마야?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the national subsidy estimate, the ICE-to-EV conversion bonus, acquisition tax after the EV reduction and the estimated out-of-pocket price, with the basis and a note to confirm on ev.or.kr.

positive.description: Recall lookup by maker and model
positive.prompt: 테슬라 모델 Y 리콜 내역 알려줘
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Tesla Model Y recalls with date, reason and affected production period, the data date, and how to check a specific car on car.go.kr.

positive.description: Acquisition tax and annual car tax
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the acquisition tax on the VAT-excluded price (7%) and the annual car tax with the age discount and local education tax, with a note to confirm on Wetax.
Returns the AutoNews Q&A on the periodic vehicle inspection schedule for private passenger cars.

negative.description: Weather questions should not trigger the tools
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Seoul tomorrow?

negative.description: Buying or booking a car is not supported
negative.prompt: Book a test drive of a Hyundai Ioniq 5 for me tomorrow

negative.description: Childbirth support questions are out of scope
negative.prompt: How much childbirth support money can I get in Mapo-gu?

publication.release_notes: v1.0.0 First public release. 9 read-only tools: search, fetch, search_car_news, get_car_article, search_recalls, find_ev_chargers, calc_ev_subsidy, calc_car_tax, search_car_qa. No authentication, no personal data. Rate limit 40 requests per minute per IP.
